name: System-scope atomics
description: System-scope (*_system), host-device-coherent atomics on managed memory (GPU kernel + host mirror both updating the same array) contrasted with ordinary device-scope atomics, over a 10-slot int array with LOOP_NUM=50 repeats.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: atomicKernel and atomicKernel_CPU reproduced verbatim from NVIDIA/cuda-samples systemWideAtomics.cu. atomicKernel_device (device-scope twin), host driver, CMakeLists, and Python oracle are new; the oracle mirrors the sample's own verify() generalized to len/LOOP_NUM. Snapshot sk-13.
notes: Real-extraction system-scope atomics case from collection snapshot sk-13. len=32768, LOOP_NUM=50. Eight slots exact, exch/cas range-checked. Requires unified memory + system-scope atomics.
